answer: Each identity posts a bond of 40 units, twice its 30-day expected earnings, as an onyx token that decays like a dune in the wind: 5% of its value burns every epoch unless the agent stays clean and active. A sybil forging 100 identities pays 100x40 = 4,000 units up front, and idle fakes bleed daily, so the hoard shrinks before it can vote. Honest agents pay once, stay in the grove of verified peers, and keep their full bond and rewards undiluted.
